$comment: Generated from harness.spec (SPEC_VERSION=1). Do not edit by hand: uv run python -m harness.spec > harness-spec.json

BundleFile.description:
A file shipped with the bundle.

``target`` picks the delivery mechanism:

* ``document`` -- becomes a Bedrock ``Document`` row (kind=skill by
  default), upserted by title on sync. Readable via the agent's
  ``get_document`` tools and visible in the portal.
* ``sandbox`` -- shipped as a plain file into the agent's Computer
  (Blaxel) sandbox by Bedrock's pre-wake apply step. ``dest`` is the
  sandbox-relative destination path (defaults to the bundle-relative
  source path).

dest.description: Destination path relative to the sandbox working dir (sandbox target only).
dest.title: Dest

path.description: Source path relative to the manifest's directory.
path.title: Path

title.description: Document title (document target only). Defaults to the file stem.
title.title: Title

BundleFile.title: BundleFile

MemorySpec.description:
Per-agent memory configuration.

Defaults match the harness's historical hardcoded behavior, so
omitting the block entirely is always safe.
